title: Shadow Watcher's conditional 'I enter ready' is applied unconditionally
expected: Reproduced with harness: scenario with 4 energy + 1 calm, no units/deaths, play unl-037-219 to base -> state isReady=true, isExhausted=false (expected exhausted per rule 143.4). Parser output for the rules text is {type:'static', effect:{type:'enter-ready'}, condition:{type:'custom', text:'If a friendly unit died during your Beginning Phase this turn'}}. In cost.ts, evaluateEnterReadyCondition has no 'custom' case and hits `default: return undefined` (lines 265-267); staticEnterReadyApplies at line 96 uses `evaluateEnterReadyCondition(...) !== false` so undefined is treated as satisfied and returns true. No engine tracking exists for 'friendly unit died during Beginning Phase' (turnEvents undefined in repro).
observed: Fresh game, turn 1 main phase, empty board, no deaths at all this game: played Shadow Watcher to base and it entered READY (state exhausted=false, card upright in screenshot). Root cause from code: parser emits condition {type:'custom', text:'If a friendly unit died during your Beginning Phase this turn'} for this text; evaluateEnterReadyCondition (moves/play/cost.ts) hits the default branch and returns undefined, and staticEnterReadyApplies treats `!== false` as satisfied, so any unrecognized enter-ready condition grants ready. There is also no engine tracking of 'friendly unit died during Beginning Phase' (state.turnEvents not populated for this).

history.note: custom enter-ready gate no longer auto-grants ready (rule 143.4): cost.ts case 'custom' evaluates the known texts, else false; die logs friendly-died-in-beginning
